ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (off-white) to 35% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated dark pigmentation at the central peduncle base. Large, irregular dark regions along the upper margins of the right lobe. Diffuse, high-contrast dark striations and speckling distributed throughout both lobes' light-colored fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated 55-degree angle and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate to high frequency serration. The left lobe trailing edge displays relatively smooth micro-variations, while the right lobe trailing edge is characterized by several distinct, sharp peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A concave curvature sweeping from the notch towards the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular bumps (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent white diagonal rake marks on the left lobe. Numerous dark, thin vertical and diagonal linear streaks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, distinct dark circular scar is visible on the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured pigmentation pattern resembling fine-line brush strokes across the entirety of the light-colored ventral surface.
